**Splinter Cell: Double Agent Widescreen Fix (Cxbx-Reloaded)** corrects HUD scaling for widescreen displays.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#scdaxbox) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/SplinterCellDoubleAgent.CXBXR.WidescreenFix/dllmain.cpp)

</div>

---

## Fixes

- **HUD** — Correct HUD scaling for widescreen.



This fix adjusts the HUD. Other gameplay and compatibility issues depend on Cxbx-Reloaded.

---

Enable Correct HUD Aspect to keep the HUD in proportion. HUD Aspect Ratio Constraint sets the HUD shape between 4:3 and 32:9; Auto uses the emulator window size at startup. Vanilla leaves HUD correction off; Recommended and Enhanced enable it. Camera field of view and video framing are unchanged.

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the Cxbx-Reloaded folder, beside the emulator executable, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Launch the game in Cxbx-Reloaded.

The fix creates its `.cfg` file beside the plugin on first startup. Change its options in FusionFixHub, then restart the emulated game.

## Presets and FusionFixHub

- Vanilla leaves HUD correction off; Recommended and Enhanced enable it. The HUD aspect ratio is the player's choice.
- Setting texts: English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.
- FusionFixHub can change the settings while Cxbx-Reloaded runs; they apply the next time the emulated game starts.
